pageDescription: FMS colours bring clarity and accessibility to the interface by visually defining how elements work. These consistent patterns make every interaction simpler and more predictable.

principles.title: Hierarchical
principles.body: Use colour to show interaction, relationships, and prominence.

principles.title: Legible
principles.body: Use colour combinations that meet legibility standards.

principles.title: Harmonious
principles.body: Use colour consistently so the interface feels unified.

guidelines.title: Contrast
guidelines.body: Ensure high contrast between text, icons, and interactive controls to support users with low vision, color blindness, or other visual impairments.

guidelines.title: Skip Colour Steps
guidelines.body: Skip at least one step on the color scale when pairing foreground and background elements to establish clear separation between surfaces, text, and controls.

guidelines.title: Maintain Consistency
guidelines.body: Apply colours predictably by assigning one colour to one role across the entire interface. Consistent usage builds recognition and strengthens UI patterns.
